answer: More aliases means more devices and more keys, each with its own juniper proof, and each must still clear the umber grading gate to earn. The nectar counter resets at epoch open, which makes the throughput ceiling permanent rather than something a patient farming party can outlast. Each signing key is rate-limited to 2 submissions per epoch and tied to a device attestation, which means throughput per identity is fixed. That is 39 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
